photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 12:06:50
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 1542 s; on-screen clock 04/27/13 12:06:50, wanted 12:06:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT13-116   MSG: 12:06:50-12:13' on 2013-04-26 (`as run matrix!B107`), read as 2013-04-26 12:06. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-04-26 plus one day, 12:06: it was found 1492 s into this video, and in no other video.
